title: Competitor registry và benchmark
scope_items: Database Migration 00011: Extended competitor_entities with platform, external_handle, relevance_score, relevance_reason, followers_count, video_count_30d, avg_views, growth_rate_30d, avg_engagement_rate, posting_frequency_per_day, last_post_at, and alert_config; created benchmark_snapshots table with composite tenant foreign key (workspace_id, competitor_id) REFERENCES competitor_entities(workspace_id, competitor_id), ENABLE/FORCE ROW LEVEL SECURITY, tenant_isolation and admin_ops_scope policies; narrow role grants to app_user and admin_user; reversible transactional down migration.

Acceptance Target 1 (Inferred insight labeled): Every inferred insight carries source_class = 'inferred', confidence band (high/medium/low), and an accessible 'Why' drawer/sheet explaining data sources, algorithmic limitations, and data gaps per RULE-M03-001 and RULE-M03-002 across Go ConnectRPC backend, SvelteKit web client, and Flutter mobile client.

Acceptance Target 2 (Stale snapshots visible): Snapshots older than 30 days are automatically flagged with is_stale = true, displaying a prominent warning badge/banner and 'Làm mới dữ liệu' (Refresh) CTA button per RULE-M03-004 across backend models, web benchmark view, and mobile benchmark screen.

Acceptance Target 3 (No assumed access to competitor finance): Strict separation of observational competitor data from accounting truth per RULE-M03-003 and EC-M03-002. Competitor revenue/profit is strictly private, displays as '—', and any attempt to feed competitor benchmarks into M19 Operating Ledger fails validation.

Screen W040 & W041 Implementation: SvelteKit Web Competitor Registry (/intelligence/competitors) and Benchmark View (/intelligence/benchmarks) with custom SVG radar chart, comparative metrics table with 🏆 leader badges, AI suggestions, and alert configuration with 60-minute minimum interval (§27.3).
Mobile Flutter Implementation: CompetitorRegistryView and BenchmarkComparisonView with CompetitorWhySheet, podium rankings, and full widget tests.
verified_sub_slices: Acceptance Target 1 Verified: TestAcceptanceTarget1_InferredInsightLabeled (Go -race), Vitest suite (web), and Flutter unit/widget tests confirm source_class=INFERRED, confidence band, and WhyExplanation data sources, limitations, and data gaps.
Acceptance Target 2 Verified: TestAcceptanceTarget2_StaleSnapshotsVisible (Go -race), Vitest suite (web), and Flutter unit/widget tests confirm >30 days staleness warning and refresh behavior.

Acceptance Target 3 Verified: TestAcceptanceTarget3_NoAssumedAccessToCompetitorFinance (Go -race), Vitest suite (web), and Flutter unit/widget tests confirm private revenue guard ('—') and rejection of financial conflation with M19 ledger/cogs.
Migration 00011 Verified: TestLoadAndValidateCanonicalP004Migration and TestUpStatusDownTransactionalBehavior pass for all 11 migrations.
Four-Target Proto Codegen Verified: check_proto.sh passes lint, generate, drift check, buf breaking backward compatibility, Go vet/test, TypeScript vitest, Dart analyze/test.

Web & Mobile Surfaces Verified: check_node.sh (svelte-check, vite build, 75 web tests + 6 admin tests), check_web_smoke.sh (SSR HTTP 200 on /intelligence/competitors and /intelligence/benchmarks), and check_flutter.sh (flutter analyze --fatal-infos --fatal-warnings + 80 tests) all pass.
external_gates: Phase P2 local mock and synthetic validation passed; live scraping/TikTok API ingress requires proxy infrastructure.
